question_variations: When do I need to clean the drip tray?
Is it necessary to clean the drip tray after each use?
intent_routes.answer: The drip tray MUST be removed and cleaned after each and EVERY use. Do not allow grease to accumulate between cooking.

intent_routes.question: What should I do if the grill grate breaks?
question_variations: Can I cook on a broken grate?
Who do I contact if the grill grate is broken?
intent_routes.answer: Do not cook on a broken grill grate. Contact an authorized service center or KENYON Customer Care immediately at (860) 664-4906.

intent_routes.question: How do I clean the grill unit?
question_variations: Can I pressure wash the grill?
What's the proper way to clean the grill?
intent_routes.answer: Never clean the grill with pressurized water or other types of cleaners. Always clean with a cloth and a stainless steel or glass surface cleaner.

intent_routes.question: How do I cook flank steak on the Kenyon Grill?
question_variations: What's the cooking time for flank steak?
How do I grill flank steak?
intent_routes.answer: Add 1 cup water to drip tray. Preheat grill for 5-7 minutes on high. Grill marinated steak for 6-8 minutes per side for medium-rare. Let stand for 10 minutes before slicing.

intent_routes.question: How do I clean the grill?
question_variations: What should I use to clean the grill?
What's the proper way to clean the grill surface?
intent_routes.answer: Clean the grill with a cloth and a stainless steel or glass surface cleaner. Use caution when cleaning hot surfaces to avoid steam burns. Some cleaners may produce noxious fumes on hot surfaces, so read cleaner labels first.

intent_routes.question: Where should I store the grill when not in use?
question_variations: How do I store my portable grill?
What storage requirements are there for built-in grills?
intent_routes.answer: Store portable grills indoors when not in use. Built-in grills must have suitable shelter to prevent direct exposure to rain. Covers are available at www.cookwithkenyon.com.

intent_routes.question: How do I prevent smoke while grilling?
question_variations: What can I do to reduce smoke?
How do I stop the drip tray from smoking?
intent_routes.answer: Place 2 cups of water (or enough to cover the bottom of the pan) in the drip tray before cooking to prevent the contents from smoking.

intent_routes.question: What does the HOT indicator light mean?
question_variations: When does the hot light turn off?
Is it safe to touch the grill when the hot light is on?
intent_routes.answer: The HOT indicator light shows that some part of the cooking grate is too warm to touch or place articles upon. Do not place anything on the cooking surface while this light is glowing. The light remains illuminated until the cooking grate is safe to touch.

intent_routes.question: How does the safety lock feature work?
question_variations: What does the lock feature do?
Can I lock the grill while cooking?
intent_routes.answer: The safety lock can be activated anytime whether the grill is ON or OFF. When ON, locking prevents power setting adjustments but allows shutdown. When OFF, locking deactivates all control panel functions until unlocked.

intent_routes.question: How do I turn on the grill?
question_variations: What's the process to start the grill?
How do I power up the grill?
intent_routes.answer: With the unit unlocked, touch the POWER button in the main control frame. Then hold the element power button in the control frame for 2 seconds and choose a cooking option. The grill will de-power if the element is not activated within 15 seconds.

intent_routes.question: What is the automatic shut-off time for heat setting 1?
question_variations: How long before heat level 1 shuts off automatically?
What's the auto-shutoff time at setting 1?
intent_routes.answer: 90 minutes
models: Single Zone Grill with IntelliKEN Touch

intent_routes.question: What temperature setting should I use for cooking fish?
question_variations: Which heat level is best for fish?
What's the recommended setting for grilling fish?
intent_routes.answer: Settings 7-8 or 9-10 are recommended for cooking fish
models: Single Zone Grill with IntelliKEN Touch

intent_routes.question: How do I fix error code E04?
question_variations: What does error E04 mean?
How to resolve E04 error?
intent_routes.answer: E04 indicates the unit is operating at high temperature. Allow unit to cool, ensure correct cooking utensil type is used, and lower the cooking level or temperature setting.
models: Single Zone Grill with IntelliKEN Touch

intent_routes.question: What happens when the timer ends?
question_variations: How does the timer alert work?
What's the timer alarm sequence?
intent_routes.answer: The display will flash and a double beep alarm will sound every ten seconds until the power button is touched. If no action is taken, the flashing display and alarm will deactivate after 3 minutes. The timer will shut off after 30 seconds of no activity.
models: Single Zone Grill with IntelliKEN Touch

intent_routes.question: Who should I contact for grill service?
question_variations: How do I get my grill serviced?
Where can I get maintenance help?
intent_routes.answer: Service must be performed by Authorized Personnel only. Call Kenyon Customer Care at 860-664-4906, M-F, 8AM – 5PM EST or email at customercare@cookwithkenyon.com
models: Single Zone Grill with IntelliKEN Touch

intent_routes.question: How do I set the temperature on the grill?
question_variations: How can I adjust the cooking temperature?
What's the process to change temperature?
How do I control the grill temperature?
intent_routes.answer: Touch the thermometer/gradient graphic to enter temperature mode. Select temperature from 150° to 550°F (65° to 287°C) using + or - buttons or by swiping the arc. Temperature changes in 10°F (12°C) increments.

intent_routes.question: What is the temperature range of the grill?
question_variations: How hot does the grill get?
What's the minimum and maximum temperature?
intent_routes.answer: The grill temperature ranges from 150°F to 550°F (65°C to 287°C)

intent_routes.question: How do I switch between Fahrenheit and Celsius?
question_variations: Can I change temperature units?
How to change from F to C?
intent_routes.answer: Touch the °F/°C button in the main power control frame to switch between Fahrenheit and Celsius. The chosen units will remain default for every use unless changed.

intent_routes.question: How does the cooking timer work?
question_variations: How do I set the timer?
Can I set a cooking time limit?
intent_routes.answer: Touch the clock graphic in the element control frame, then use + and - buttons to set time. Timer runs 1-10 minutes in 1-minute increments, then changes to 5-minute increments. Touch timer button to start. The element automatically shuts off when time expires.

intent_routes.question: What happens when the cooking timer finishes?
question_variations: Does the grill turn off when timer ends?
What occurs at the end of timed cooking?
intent_routes.answer: The burner automatically shuts off, the display flashes, and a double beep alarm sounds every 10 seconds. This continues until the power button is touched or automatically deactivates after 3 minutes.

intent_routes.question: How many heat levels does the grill have?
question_variations: What are the heat settings?
How many temperature settings are there?
intent_routes.answer: The grill has 16 heat level increments ranging from LOW to MED to HIGH, indicated by the LED light array along the control sweep.

intent_routes.question: What is the default heat level when starting?
question_variations: What heat setting does the grill start at?
Initial heat level when turned on?
intent_routes.answer: The default heat level upon starting any element is 0. The default temperature in temperature cooking mode is 150°F (65°C).

intent_routes.question: How do I remove the lid from the grill?
question_variations: Can I take the lid off?
What's the process for removing the grill lid?
How does the lid come off for cleaning?
intent_routes.answer: Remove the quick release pin from the hinge, then grasp the lid and lift on the left side to clear the hinge. Slide it to the left until clear of the hinge pin on the right.

intent_routes.question: What are the electrical requirements for installation?
question_variations: How much power does the grill need?
What voltage does the grill use?
What are the power specifications?
intent_routes.answer: Model B70750 requires 48V DC 27A with max connected load of 1300 Watts. Voltage range is MIN 35V DC to MAX 55V DC. For power supply runs up to 40 feet, 8AWG wiring is required.

intent_routes.question: How do I clean the grill grate?
question_variations: What's the best way to clean the grating?
Can I wash the grill grate?
How should I maintain the grate?
intent_routes.answer: The grate must be cleaned after every use. It has a nonstick coating and should be washed in warm soapy water after each use.

intent_routes.question: What should I do with the drip tray?
question_variations: How do I use the drip tray?
Do I need to empty the drip tray?
How do I prevent the drip tray from smoking?
intent_routes.answer: Empty the drip tray after each use. To prevent smoking, add 2 cups of water before cooking. When installing, ensure the drip tray is completely contained inside the baffle tray with no rim protrusion.

intent_routes.question: What parts come with the grill?
question_variations: What's included in the grill package?
What accessories come with the grill?
What should be in the box?
intent_routes.answer: The package includes: VDC IntelliKEN Touch™, stainless steel cleaner, 3 feet of drain hose with brass fitting, and 4 mounting screws.

intent_routes.question: What are the power requirements for model B70750?
question_variations: What voltage does the B70750 grill need?
How many watts does model B70750 use?
What's the electrical specification for B70750?
intent_routes.answer: The B70750 requires 48V DC 27A power supply input with a maximum connected load of 1300 Watts

intent_routes.question: What wire gauge is needed for power supply installation?
question_variations: What size wire should I use for the power supply?
What AWG is required for power connection?
intent_routes.answer: 8 AWG wire is required for power supply runs up to 40 feet

intent_routes.question: How do I seal the grill to the countertop?
question_variations: What should I use to seal the grill edge?
How do I install the grill seal?
intent_routes.answer: Use non-adhesive Plumber's Putty to seal the edge of the countertop beneath the trim flange. For granite, marble, quartz, sandstone or Corian countertops, use stain-free Plumber's Putty to prevent staining

intent_routes.question: What is the minimum cabinet clearance above the grill?
question_variations: How much space is needed above the cooking surface?
What's the required overhead cabinet distance?
intent_routes.answer: 30 inches minimum clearance between the top of the cooking surface and unprotected cabinets, or 24 inches minimum when cabinet is protected with flame retardant materials

intent_routes.question: What is the minimum clearance needed below the grill?
question_variations: How much space is required under the grill?
What's the bottom clearance requirement?
intent_routes.answer: 2 inch minimum clearance is required between the bottom of the grill and any combustible surface located below

intent_routes.question: What ventilation requirements are needed for the grill cabinet?
question_variations: How much ventilation does the grill need?
What are the air flow requirements for installation?
How should I ventilate the grill cabinet?
intent_routes.answer: The cabinet requires two openings - one for fresh air intake and one for hot air escape. Each opening must be minimum 8 square inches for ambient temperatures up to 85°F/30°C. Larger openings may be required for higher ambient temperatures.

intent_routes.question: How should I prepare the grill before first use?
question_variations: What do I need to do before using the grill first time?
How do I set up the grill initially?
What are the first-time setup steps?
intent_routes.answer: 1. Remove protective plastic film from lid, trim flange, and glass panel. 2. Clean thoroughly with stainless steel or glass cleaner to remove adhesives and manufacturing oils. 3. Wash nonstick coated grates in warm soapy water.
references: Final Preparations Prior to Use section

intent_routes.question: What are the drain connection specifications?
question_variations: How do I connect the drain?
What type of drain fitting does the grill use?
What size is the drain connection?
intent_routes.answer: The grill comes with a 1/2" NPT brass pipe fitting and 90° brass elbow for attaching the included 5/8" ID flexible hose. Portable versions come with a brass pipe plug installed in the drain fitting.

intent_routes.question: How should I cut the countertop for installation?
question_variations: What's the proper way to make the countertop cutout?
How do I prepare the counter for grill installation?
What radius is needed for the countertop cut?
intent_routes.answer: Radius the corners of the cutout to prevent cracking. Typically use 1/4 inch radius, but follow countertop manufacturer's instructions for minimum radius and reinforcement requirements.

intent_routes.question: What precautions are needed for stone countertops?
question_variations: How do I protect my granite countertop during installation?
What should I use for marble counter installation?
How do I prevent countertop staining?
intent_routes.answer: For granite, marble, quartz, sandstone or Corian countertops, use a stain-free Plumber's Putty to prevent staining of the countertop material.

intent_routes.question: How long is the warranty period for electronic components?
question_variations: What's the electronic component warranty duration?
How many years are electronic parts covered?
When does the electronic warranty expire?
intent_routes.answer: Electronic components are warranted for three years from original installation date or 42 months from invoice date, whichever comes first. This covers parts and labor at pre-approved rates.

intent_routes.question: What is the warranty coverage for stainless steel?
question_variations: How long is stainless steel warranted for?
Is there a lifetime warranty on stainless steel?
What's the rust warranty on stainless steel?
intent_routes.answer: Stainless steel has a lifetime guarantee to be rust free when cared for monthly as outlined in the owner's manual. If corrosion occurs, contact the company with photo evidence for replacement components.

intent_routes.question: What damages are not covered under warranty?
question_variations: What voids the warranty?
Which problems aren't covered by warranty?
When does the warranty not apply?
intent_routes.answer: The warranty doesn't cover damages from: misuse of product in unintended applications, corrosion, wear and tear, abuse, neglect, improper installation or maintenance, and breakage of glass (accidental or otherwise).

intent_routes.question: Who pays for shipping under warranty?
question_variations: Is shipping covered by warranty?
What are the warranty shipping terms?
Do I have to pay for warranty shipping?
intent_routes.answer: Kenyon covers ground shipping charges within Continental United States and Canada. Any duties, express or special shipping charges are the buyer's responsibility.

intent_routes.question: How do I return a product under warranty?
question_variations: What's the warranty return process?
How can I claim warranty service?
What's the procedure for warranty returns?
intent_routes.answer: Contact kenyonservice@cookwithkenyon.com for return instructions. All warranty labor must be pre-authorized and performed by an Authorized Kenyon International Service Center unless specified otherwise in writing.
